questions.text: Which 2004 stoner comedy features a cameo by actor Neil Patrick Harris playing himself?
options: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle
questions.explanation: Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle includes Neil Patrick Harris playing a fictionalized version of himself, a classic stoner-comedy cameo.

questions.text: Which 2008 stoner comedy follows a process server and his drug dealer who must flee from a corrupt police officer and a drug lord?
questions.explanation: In the 2008 stoner comedy 'Pineapple Express,' Seth Rogen and James Franco star as a process server and his drug dealer who go on the run after witnessing a murder.

In which year was the stoner comedy film 'Harold & Kumar Go to White Castle' released?

questions.text: In the 2001 stoner comedy How High, what three-digit number is central to retrieving a mystical form of marijuana?
questions.explanation: In How High, the number 406 refers to the mailbox combination the characters must dial to access their weed supplier's orders from beyond the grave.

questions.text: Which director helmed the 2008 stoner comedy featuring a process server and his drug dealer on the run?
questions.explanation: David Gordon Green directed the 2008 stoner comedy Pineapple Express, which features a complex blend of action and comedy.
